newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania govt approves revised '97 budget.
newsitem.headline: Romania govt approves revised '97 budget.

text.p: Romania's governent has approved a revised 1997 budget, keeping the deficit at 4.5 percent of gross domestic product as directed by the IMF, Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu said on Wednesday.

"The (revised) budget has been approved. It maintains the deficit within the 4.5-percent target," Spineanu told reporters as ministers emerged from talks with the International Monetary Fund's chief negotiator.
